title: Impossible to dismiss the context menu of a xembed systray icon by clicking outside it
line: Clicking outside the menu of an older X11 tray icon (HexChat, Pidgin, Wine apps) now closes it on Wayland, as it does on X11.
explanation: GTK2 and other X11 menus grab the pointer and close themselves when the grab reports a button press outside of them. On Wayland a click on the desktop, panel or any Wayland window goes straight to that window, so Xwayland never sees it and the menu stays open; tray icon menus are hit hardest because there is no app window to click back into. Xwayland also still thinks the pointer is wherever it was last over an X11 window (for tray menus, on the icon, inside the menu). KWin now notices a press on a non-X11 surface while an X11 popup is shown and some X11 client holds a pointer grab, moves the X pointer to the real click position and sends the press (and its release) to Xwayland instead, so the menu closes exactly like on X11.

commits.message:
xwayland: Forward presses on Wayland windows to grabbing X11 popups

X11 menus close when their pointer grab sees a press outside of them,
but presses on Wayland windows never reached Xwayland, so menus like
those of xembed tray icons stayed open. Now these presses reach it.

BUG: 453946
